At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.
Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!
# Data Enablement Officer
Help shape how Efficio uses data responsibly, securely and effectively.
We are looking for a Data Enablement Officer to establish and lead Efficio’s data governance framework, helping us protect client data while enabling its responsible use across our services, analytics, products and AI capabilities.
This is a highly visible role at the intersection of data, technology, AI, risk and client delivery. You will work across the business to turn complex contractual, regulatory, privacy and security requirements into practical guidance that enables teams to innovate with confidence.
Initially, the role will have a strong advisory and enablement focus: helping teams understand client requirements, assess new uses of data and make proportionate, risk-based decisions. As our governance model matures, the role is expected to take greater ownership of the framework and delegated authority for lower-risk decisions.
## What you'll be doing
### Establish our data governance framework
You will assess our current data-handling practices and develop a practical, scalable governance framework covering the lifecycle of client data – from collection and classification through to access, use, sharing, storage, retention and secure deletion.
You will develop and maintain policies and standards covering areas including:
* Client data handling and classification
* Data reuse and fair usage
* Use of client data within Efficio products
* Use of data with AI tools, including third-party and self-hosted solutions
* Data access and security
* Retention, archiving and secure disposal
* Anonymisation and aggregation
* Third-party data sharing
* Policy exceptions and escalation
You will also help establish and maintain our information asset inventories, data flows and AI asset registers.
### Enable responsible use of data and AI
A key part of the role will be helping teams determine what we can do with data, under what conditions, and with what safeguards.
You will establish a consistent approach for assessing new and changing data use cases, considering factors such as:
* Why the data was originally obtained
* Client and contractual restrictions
* Data sensitivity and classification
* The proposed use and intended recipients
* Security and access controls
* Retention requirements
* Legal, client and reputational considerations
For AI use cases, you will help define which activities are permitted, restricted, require additional review or are prohibited. This will include the use of prompts, uploaded files and connected data sources, as well as expectations around human oversight, output validation and accountability.
### Govern products, platforms and technology
You will define the conditions under which client data can be stored or processed using Efficio products, SaaS platforms, cloud services and AI tools.
Working closely with Technology, Information Security, Legal and Privacy teams, you will assess areas including:
* Data residency and international transfers
* Encryption, access controls and logging
* Supplier and subcontractor access
* Data retention, backups and deletion
* Exit and data-export arrangements
* Use of customer data for AI model training, product improvement or other secondary purposes
You will help ensure that unapproved platforms are not used for client data without appropriate assessment and documented approval.
### Support new solutions and innovation
You will work alongside teams designing and deploying new data, software, analytics and AI solutions, providing governance input from an early stage.
Ahead of launch, you will help confirm that the appropriate governance, legal, privacy and security reviews have taken place and that material risks have been appropriately addressed.
Where issues remain, you will recommend practical remediation, escalation or, where necessary, a delay to rollout. Acceptance of significant residual risk will remain with the appropriate executive or governance committee.
### Build governance that works in practice
This role isn't simply about writing policies. We want to create a governance model that teams can understand and use.
You will help develop:
* A clear data governance operating model and decision-rights framework
* Practical data, AI, security, reuse and retention policies
* Data and AI use-case assessment processes
* Risk-classification and escalation models
* Policy exception processes and decision registers
* Product and AI platform assessment standards
* Solution launch-readiness checklists
* Training, guidance and supporting materials
* Governance reporting for senior leadership and relevant committees
You will coordinate, advise and constructively challenge stakeholders across the organisation while recognising that responsibility for managing data risk is shared across business owners, data owners, Legal and Privacy, Information Security, Technology and senior governance forums.
## Client engagement
This will also be an important client-facing role.
You will participate in client discussions where required, confidently explaining Efficio's approach to data governance, security and responsible data use.
You should be comfortable responding to questions about how client data is accessed, used, stored, shared, retained and protected, translating technical or governance concepts into clear, credible explanations for different audiences.
## What we're looking for
We are looking for someone with experience across one or more of the following areas:
* Data governance or data management
* Data privacy
* Information security
* Technology or operational risk
* AI governance or responsible AI
You will also bring a practical understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS, cloud, analytics and AI platforms.
You'll be someone who can operate comfortably between policy and practice – able to understand complex requirements while recognising the commercial and operational realities of a consulting and technology-enabled business.
In particular, you will be able to:
* Translate complex regulatory, contractual and security requirements into practical business guidance
* Apply proportionate, risk-based judgement rather than relying on a purely rules-based approach
* Influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively
* Work effectively across Technology, Security, Legal, Privacy and business teams
* Balance commercial objectives and innovation with appropriate governance
* Communicate confidently with clients and senior internal stakeholders
* Build processes and frameworks that are robust without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
* Navigate emerging areas where the answer may not always be immediately clear
## What success looks like
Success in this role will mean that teams understand how to use data appropriately rather than simply being told what they cannot do.
We will look at measures including adoption of priority policies, review turnaround times, reduction in unapproved tool usage, effective management of exceptions, quality of governance reporting, stakeholder feedback and a reduction in recurring governance issues.
Ultimately, the role will be judged on its ability to achieve both sides of our data ambition: protecting our clients and Efficio while enabling appropriate, secure and innovative use of data and AI.

Passionate about Sustainability – you want to deepen your understanding of the risks and opportunities that exist within our terrestrial and marine food systems today.
Excellent research and analytical skills—both qualitative and quantitative—with strong attention to detail. For context, CAPE (also known as the Shiller P/E, after co-creator Robert Shiller) is a commonly cited market valuation metric that divides the S&P 500's current price by the prior decade's average, inflation-adjusted earnings. Its original purpose was to project 10-year forward returns, but many have morphed this, using it to try to time turning points in US equity markets. It doesn't work, as we will show, but the meme persists.
Today's worries surround the S&P 500's CAPE surpassing 40.0 in May before rising to 42.06 today. This, pundits warn, creeps dangerously close to the measure's 44.19 all-time high in December 1999, roughly three months before the dot-com bubble burst and a bear market began. Given current AI hype, many connect the dots and presume this means US stocks are "too expensive," opening the door to a prolonged bloodbath as investors' expectations become impossible for corporate results to match.
Look, we agree there are some pockets of hot sentiment. But using CAPE as a timing tool is a faulty approach built on a broken indicator. Consider CAPE's bizarrely adjusting past earnings (the denominator) for inflation but leaving today's price (its numerator) unadjusted. This suppresses the denominator - especially following periods of hot inflation - artificially lifting CAPE and making stocks appear "more expensive." It is a bizarre thing to do when you consider both sides of the earnings equation - costs and revenues - are subject to inflation, making nominal profits a sign of whether companies are overcoming price pressures. We think inflation-adjusting them in any context misses the point, especially when there are other, more useful means of scaling.
CAPE also uses a decade of past earnings (versus the more traditional 12-month trailing P/E), aiming to avoid skew from booms or recessions. While that is perhaps a laudable aim, the solution makes the gauge *very* backward looking, allowing events from years ago to influence today's CAPE. We think this, in and of itself, adds skew. Consider: Long after the fact, the deep 2008 recession depressed 10-year trailing corporate earnings, exaggerating CAPE. Similarly, today's CAPE includes 2020's COVID lockdown-driven downturn (long since over and done with) and the earnings slump that followed hot inflation in late 2022 and early 2023. All that is behind us, way behind us in some cases. Conversely, stocks look forward, pricing in the likeliest factors to influence earnings 3 - 30 months ahead. Earnings from 10 years ago don't affect today's.

Perhaps that is why CAPE has been a poor market cycle predictor. Exhibit 1 helps shows this, charting the S&P's CAPE at the beginning of each bear market - and each bear market's cumulative decline - since 1925, when good data begin. For context, CAPE's median since 1925 is 17.82.
**Exhibit 1:** Fluttering CAPE
Source: FactSet and Multpl.com, as of 8/18/2026. S&P 500 price return and CAPE, 12/31/1924 - 8/17/2026.
As you can see, no CAPE level clearly or consistently signals a new bear market start or predicts a decline's magnitude. Bear markets started with below-median CAPE in 1946, 1980, 1987 and 1990. And while the rest began above this mark, CAPE varies widely in these years - ranging from 18.67 - 43.53. There is no magical level that predicts bear markets. As for magnitude, the three highest recorded CAPEs here - March 2000's 43.53, January 2022's 36.94, and September 1929's 32.56 - preceded widely varying declines. March 1937's much milder 22.04, meanwhile, saw stocks drop a whopping -60.0% over the next five years. There is no real connection there.
CAPE fears (sorry) in the 2010s provide further color. CAPE floated around its 1929 peak throughout much of the decade, eventually exceeding it in early 2018. This was a of among pundits, though it was an excellent decade for stocks. While 2018 was tough, valuations were coincident to stocks' performance. The majority of that year's slump started in late September and reached its apex in December, when numerous hedge funds were assets to meet redemption requests and planned closures. CAPE had nothing to do with forced selling, which resulted from years of poor fund performance.
Ditto 2020's bear market, which had everything to do with COVID lockdowns and nothing to do with hot sentiment or stocks being "too expensive." While sentiment was hot heading into 2022's shallow bear market, with pockets of euphoria in Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs) and other niche corners, you wouldn't see those in the S&P 500's CAPE. There are other, better sentiment gauges that catch true euphoria.
Reacting to CAPE at the wrong time can have consequences. Rewind to a famous example: December 5, 1996, when then-Fed chair Alan Greenspan famously questioned if investors' "irrational exuberance" had "unduly escalated asset values." Just two days prior, Shiller briefed Greenspan on CAPE's rise, so it stands to reason the Fed chair had it in mind. Yet that bull market continued for more than three years, with US stocks more than doubling.
This bull market will eventually end, as all do. And yes, we do think currently elevated sentiment shows we are in this bull market's latter stages. Yet those latter stages can last longer than you think - and CAPE won't help you navigate that.

## Job Description
We are looking for an experienced and innovative Environmental Testing & Degradation Mitigation (ETDM) Manager to lead a high-profile environmental qualification and degradation mitigation programme valued at approximately £6 million over three years. This strategic leadership role will play a pivotal part in ensuring that materials, components and systems can withstand the demanding environments encountered within a fusion power plant.
Working closely with the Fusion Partner (UKAEA), universities, research organisations and industrial partners, you will drive the generation of the environmental performance evidence needed to support design substantiation, regulatory compliance, inspection and maintenance strategies, and long-term plant reliability.
**The Opportunity**
As the recognised subject matter expert for environmental durability and degradation risks, you will sit at the intersection of materials science, reliability engineering, systems engineering and experimental validation.
You will lead multidisciplinary teams to develop environmental testing programmes, identify degradation mechanisms, assess risks to plant performance, and implement mitigation strategies that support the successful delivery of the STEP Prototype Plant and future commercial fusion facilities.
This role focuses on non-irradiated environmental degradation and qualification, working in close partnership with irradiation science and materials modelling teams to ensure a joined-up approach to materials qualification.
**Key Responsibilities**
Environmental Testing Strategy & Programme Leadership
* Develop and own the environmental testing and degradation qualification strategy for critical STEP systems, materials and components.
* Define testing roadmaps aligned with product development milestones, design maturity and regulatory requirements.
* Lead the planning, prioritisation and execution of component and system-level environmental test campaigns.
* Work closely with the Design Authority to ensure evidence generation supports key engineering and qualification decisions.
Degradation Assessment & Mitigation
* Lead investigations into degradation and failure mechanisms including:
+ Thermal fatigue and ratcheting
+ Creep and creep-fatigue interaction
+ Embrittlement
+ Corrosion, oxidation and stress corrosion cracking
+ Erosion and sputtering
+ Hydrogen and tritium-related effects
+ Electrical insulation ageing and breakdown
+ Seal, coating and joining degradation
* Develop practical mitigation strategies through:
+ Material selection and qualification
+ Surface engineering and coatings
+ Design improvements
+ Environmental controls
+ Inspection, maintenance and replacement planning
* Ensure test findings are translated into design requirements, materials databases and lifecycle models.
Programme Delivery & Resource Management
* Develop and maintain a long-term ETDM strategy aligned with programme objectives, timescales and funding profiles.
* Manage programme budgets and forecasts, ensuring delivery against technical, schedule and cost targets.
* Provide robust justification for future investment and resource requirements.
* Ensure all activities remain focused on supporting STEP materials qualification and design substantiation objectives.
Innovation & Economic Impact
* Foster a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
* Identify opportunities to apply novel qualification approaches beyond the fusion sector.
* Promote effective management of intellectual property, inventions and patents.
* Encourage publication and dissemination of research where appropriate.
Stakeholder Engagement & Reporting
* Build strong communication pathways across the STEP programme and wider stakeholder community.
* Present technical progress and strategic updates to senior leadership and programme boards.
* Contribute to technical reviews, advisory groups, business planning activities and government reporting.
* Represent the programme at conferences, industry forums and technical collaborations.
Leadership
* Create an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team culture.
* Provide leadership across multidisciplinary technical teams and external partnerships.
* Champion organisational values and act as a role model for professional excellence.
* Make sound, risk-informed decisions that support programme success.
**About You**
We are seeking a recognised technical leader with a strong track record in environmental qualification, materials degradation, reliability engineering or a related discipline.
You will bring:
* Degree qualification in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a related field (PhD desirable).
* Significant experience leading complex R&D, testing or qualification programmes within highly regulated or safety-critical industries.
* Strong understanding of material degradation mechanisms and lifetime assessment methodologies.
* Experience developing and delivering environmental testing strategies and qualification programmes.
* Expertise in one or more sectors such as fusion, nuclear, aerospace, energy, oil & gas, defence or advanced manufacturing.
* Proven ability to influence technical direction and support engineering decision-making.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams, budgets and external collaborations.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Desirable Experience
* Knowledge of fusion energy systems and extreme operating environments.
* Familiarity with high heat flux systems, vacuum environments, cryogenic systems, corrosive coolants or tritium-related challenges.
* Experience supporting design reviews, FMEA/FMECA activities and safety assessments.
* Understanding of irradiation-assisted degradation and materials modelling approaches.
* Track record of publishing technical research, securing patents or managing intellectual property.
**Why Join Us?**
This is a rare opportunity to influence one of the most ambitious engineering programmes in the world. You'll help solve some of the toughest materials and reliability challenges in fusion energy while working alongside leading experts from industry, academia and government.
Join us and help deliver the technologies that could power a sustainable future.

The Senior Quality Manager is a key leadership role within the Safety, Quality & Mission Assurance (SQ&MA) function, responsible for defining and delivering the Quality Strategy for the STEP fusion programme. # Quality Assurance Executive - Product Integrity - 12 Month FCT
Solihull, England, United Kingdom
**THE ROLE.**
At Gymshark, we're committed to creating products that perform, fit flawlessly and exceed expectations. As a **Product Integrity Quality Executive**, you'll play a vital role in ensuring every product is ready for launch by driving quality excellence throughout the product development journey.
Working within either our Men's, Women's or Seamless category, you'll partner with Product Development, Materials, Regional Quality teams and global suppliers to ensure products are safe, compliant and manufactured to the highest standards. From identifying potential risks during development to validating bulk fabrics and approving pre-production samples, you'll help make sure every detail is right before production begins.
#### WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING.
#### Drive Product Quality from Development to Production
* Support the Quality Assurance Manager in delivering industry-leading product quality across your category.
* Review new product developments to identify and mitigate quality, fit, performance and compliance risks.
* Collaborate with development teams and suppliers to ensure technical requirements are fully understood and accurately executed.
* Assess wearer trial feedback and product performance data to support informed decision-making.
#### Lead Quality Validation Activities
* Manage bulk fabric and raw material validation processes.
* Evaluate garment and material testing results to ensure products meet Gymshark standards.
* Review technical documentation and specifications to ensure production readiness.
* Identify critical manufacturing processes requiring enhanced quality control measures.
#### Own Pre-Production Quality Sign-Off
* Oversee the Pre-Production Sample (PPS) approval process, ensuring products meet requirements for fit, measurements, materials, trims and construction.
* Support and facilitate Pre-Production Meetings (PPMs), ensuring all stakeholders are aligned and actions are clearly assigned.
* Communicate category-specific quality controls to suppliers and regional quality teams.
* Ensure all outstanding issues are resolved before production commences.
#### Drive Continuous Improvement
* Investigate product quality issues and claims, identifying root causes and corrective actions.
* Work cross-functionally to embed learnings into future product development.
* Maintain accurate records, approvals and reporting metrics to support business performance and continuous improvement initiatives.
#### WHAT YOU'LL NEED.
#### Essential Skills & Experience
* Bachelor's degree in Apparel Design, Textile Engineering, Quality Management or a related discipline.
* Previous experience within quality assurance, product integrity or quality management in the apparel, sportswear or textile industry.
* Strong understanding of textile materials, garment construction and apparel manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of fabric, garment and performance testing standards.
* Experience reviewing laboratory test reports and validating product performance.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across multiple teams and supplier partners.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Excel and digital product or quality management systems.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a proactive approach to problem solving.
#### We'd Love to See
* Experience working with global suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* A passion for continuous improvement and process optimisation.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking capabilities.
* Experience working within a high-growth, fast-moving retail or sportswear environment.
**Onsite Collaboration:** Due to the hands-on and highly collaborative nature of the work within our Product & Supply Chain team, **we have a minimum expectation of THREE days per week onsite** at our Gymshark HQ. This ensures we can work closely together to innovate, problem-solve, and deliver world-class products for our community.

We’re an equal opportunities employer, and for us that means we always strive to be as inclusive as possible in all aspects of employment, right from your application. # Pricing Actuary
Reference Number: 3274
Contract Type: Regular
Working Time: Full-Time
**Hannover Re** – as one of the world’s leading reinsurers, we provide coverage for the risks of yesterday, today and tomorrow. Our strength? **Connecting Power:** Within our global team of around 4,000 colleagues, we bring together knowledge, perspectives and a strong sense of responsibility. We rely on one another, challenge ourselves and continuously develop both our services and our products. Whether working with risk calculation models, developing digital tools or creating pragmatic solutions for our clients: here, you can contribute your expertise and actively shape what comes next. **Sounds good?** Get to know us as a reliable employer and find your place with us.
**Company Profile:**
The Hannover Re Group (www.hannover-re.com) is one of the world’s leading reinsurers and Hannover Re (Ireland) DAC (“HRI”) is a wholly owned subsidiary.
With approximately 4,000 staff worldwide, HRI employs 64 professionals in its Dublin office.
At HRI we strive to attract high quality talent and creative thinkers to realise our vision - to be *Somewhat Different*. HRI has a collaborative management philosophy and non-hierarchical environment which offers a unique and attractive working environment. We focus on attracting rounded and exceptional talent with long-term potential.
We recognise that the skills and expertise of our people are core to the success of our Company. We take a long-term view on development, placing emphasis on challenging our people to realise their ambitions within a supportive, fast-paced team environment. We have a strong track record of providing career progression opportunities, both locally and internationally.
We have active Sports & Social, Charity and Green Committees and we offer a flexible working environment.
**The Role:**
We are seeking a Pricing Actuary to lead new business acquisition which delivers client-centric reinsurance solutions and to play a critical role in the development of our Life and Health strategy.
This role is a call to self-driven unstructured problem solvers and is challenging, exciting and highly varied. It requires a candidate with solid industry experience, an understanding of life and health reinsurance across global markets as well as strong technical, communication and influencing skills.
The role will operate in an international environment, and the successful candidate will be expected to coordinate and work with international colleagues across the Hannover Re Group, in particular with Life and Health teams in Bermuda, Germany, Canada, Asia and Australasia.
The successful candidate will gain exposure to all aspects of the reinsurance business and be an integral part of the global Hannover Re team.
Working with a highly adept actuarial team, you will be provided the opportunity to lead transactions, demonstrate and enhance your skill set and to develop your own profile within the worldwide business.
**Duties & Responsibilities**:
Pricing
The responsibilities of the role will span all aspects of actuarial pricing and new business acquisition, including:
* Evaluate new business opportunities sourced from within the Hannover Re L&H world-wide network
* Set and review pricing assumptions
* Manage internal relationships and key stakeholders while managing successful acquisition and onboarding
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of regulatory, accounting and economic impacts of prospective transactions
* Design and review bespoke reinsurance solutions to meet the diverse needs of our clients
* Work collaboratively across time zones and geographies with Hannover Re entities globally on new business opportunities and where required, supporting this activity with international travel
* Effectively communicate how complex reinsurance solutions operate, the effect on our risk profile and the financial and economic outcomes to the senior leadership team including the CEO, Business Centre Head L&H, CFO, Head of Corporate Actuarial and CRO
* Draft and review treaty wordings and transaction summary documentation
* Prepare and deliver presentations to internal colleagues on the latest pricing developments
* Maintain pricing procedures and underwriting guidelines in accordance with Hannover Re requirements and regulatory best practice
* Any other ad-hoc responsibilities and requirements in line with the priorities and needs of the Pricing department
Marketing and Strategy
* Contribute to the development and implementation of the L&H strategy
* Identify opportunities to support Business Centres within the Group
* Proactively identify and develop potential client opportunities across Europe for bespoke reinsurance solutions in collaboration with local markets, supporting both early-stage marketing initiatives and R&D activities
* Represent HRI pricing team at various internal Group workshops and external conferences
* Work alongside the L&H Business Centre Head in building and maintaining strong relationships with the Company’s direct and internal clients
Regulation and Local Marketplace
* Actively monitor the changing regulatory environment internationally and locally (Solvency II/ IFRS 17) and assess impact on existing business and new business opportunities
* Contribute to discussions within the Hannover Re Group on matters affecting new business, product development and economic solvency capital requirements
* Attend international reinsurance industry meetings to monitor developments in relevant markets
**Education and Experience:**
* Qualified actuary with 2+ years post qualification experience
* Experience of life reinsurance is favourable, particularly in a pricing or structuring role
* International experience of reinsurance business across different regulatory and accounting regimes, geographies, reinsurance structures, product designs beneficial
* Advanced knowledge of European solvency and regulatory requirements
**Skills:**
* Strong analytical and technical capability with curious, creative approach to client solutions
* Time management – proven ability to manage competing priorities under challenging deadlines
* Critical thinker – performs independent assessments in new situations with the confidence to challenge the status quo
* Strategic – proactively identifies and drives business opportunities as they present themselves, influencing the key stakeholders
**Person Specification:**
* Team player and collaborative in nature – works well with others and takes time to share knowledge
* A self-driven unstructured problem solver
* Applies initiative and demonstrates accountability for own role
* Demonstrates capacity to influence decisions and manage relationships with key stakeholders both in HRI (Senior Leadership Team & Board) and across the Group internationally
* Excellent communication skills to present solutions to non-technical and culturally diverse clients in a clear and concise manner
* Adaptable and flexible approach to work

You will own how we measure **control quality - per robot and across the fleet**. Today, judging whether a change made the robot better is still too often an engineer's opinion after a few runs. You will replace that with numbers: reproducible, automated, trusted numbers that say whether a release is better than the last one, whether one robot behaves like another, and whether a fleet is ready for a pilot.

* Develop automated test harnesses that evaluate control releases deterministically - reproducible, run-to-run comparable, free of the hidden state that makes hardware testing unreliable.

We are looking for a Senior **Low-level Control Engineer** to join our **Control Team** in London, focusing on control development and integration for our **end-effectors**.
You will design, implement and validate **actuator- and joint-level controllers** and **grasp-level behaviours** across a family of end-effector variants - parallel and multi-finger grippers, vacuum and suction tooling, and purpose-built tooling for specific customer tasks. Each variant brings different actuation, different sensing and, critically, **different transmission mechanisms**: geared direct drives, cable- and tendon-driven routings, differential and coupled linkages, and underactuated designs where few actuators must produce adaptive, compliant grasping across many degrees of freedom.
The ideal candidate has a **solid background in control theory**, strong **software engineering skills in C++**, and comfort working from real-time embedded control up through kinematics/dynamics and hardware debugging. You will work closely with mechanical and hardware engineers - early enough in the design cycle that your input shapes actuation and transmission choices rather than merely inheriting them.

**Low-Level Control Development:**
* Tune and validate actuator- and joint-space control loops (PID, feedforward, impedance/admittance, observers, state feedback) for multi-DoF end-effectors in ROS2.
* Develop grasp-level behaviours: grasp force control, compliant closing, slip detection and correction, and adaptive grasping on underactuated grippers.
* Implement safety and fault-handling mechanisms — thermal and over-current protection, stall and jam detection, grip-loss detection, safe behaviour on fault.
**Transmission Mechanisms, Modeling & System Identification:**
* Build and identify models of actuators, transmissions and mechanisms - geared, cable/tendon-driven, differential, coupled and underactuated - including compliance, friction, backlash, hysteresis, cable stretch and pretension effects.
* Own the joint-to-actuator abstraction for these mechanisms and the correct exposure of joint versus actuator state through the control stack.
* Contribute directly to transmission mechanism design: work with mechanical engineers on routing, reduction ratios, DoF coupling and underactuation strategy, bringing the controllability and observability consequences of each option into the conversation early.
**Sensor & Hardware Integration:**

* Tuned and validated controllers on physical actuators, including sensor calibration and bring-up.

# People & Talent Product Engineer
Hi | I'm Ash Rama, VP People at hyperexponential.
I lead the team responsible for how hx makes decisions about its people: comp, performance, org design, and increasingly, the systems and tools that power all of it. We don't buy software off the shelf when it doesn't fit how we actually want to work, we want to build it ourselves, bespoke to hx. This means shipping everything from simple internal letter-writing tools to a full multi-level compensation platform used by every employee and manager here.
I'm hiring a product engineer to join the People & Talent team, within Central Functions and become the builder behind these tools: someone who can take a prototype, decide how it should actually work and feel for the person using it, then build it out to the highest of hx standards, end to end, back end, data, infrastructure, and ship something that holds up under real use.
This isn't a typical engineering role. You'll sit close to People & Talent day to day, but work alongside our IT and Security teams to make sure everything we build is secure and compliant by design, not bolted on after the fact. I think this is the future of how People functions will operate in the AI era: technical, product-minded, building rather than configuring. If that excites you more than a conventional engineering role would, I'd love to hear from you.
# About Central Functions
Central Functions is the core of hx, laying the road for the business to execute on. We bring together Finance, Legal, People, Talent, and Business Operations, the connective tissue that lets every other part of hx move fast with confidence. You'll sit inside this function, working closely with People & Talent day to day, and partnering with IT and Security to make sure everything you build is secure and compliant from the ground up.
# Reporting line and engineering partnership
This role reports into our VP People. You'll also work in close partnership with a senior or staff-level engineer from our core Engineering team, who'll sense-check technical decisions and review your work. This isn't day-to-day pairing or management; you'll operate with real autonomy, with that partnership acting as a technical backstop rather than a supervisor. We're looking for someone with 2-4 years' experience who can own a build with real autonomy.
# What you'll be doing
* Act as product engineer for People & Talent, owning the full arc from problem framing and experience design through to technical build and delivery, for tools spanning simple internal utilities to our multi-level compensation platform.
* Make the UI and design calls that matter for how people across hx actually experience these tools, whether that's an employee submitting a request or a manager running calibration, turning "we need this to work" into something genuinely well-designed and intuitive.
* Take front-end prototypes built across People & Talent and turn them into production-ready products, full stack: building out the back end, data model, and infrastructure to make them reliable and scalable.
* Spec new builds properly before writing code, mapping the experience and delivery plan (who uses it, how, what "done" looks like) alongside the technical architecture, so nothing gets built twice or built wrong.
* Iterate on live tools based on real user feedback, treating internal People & Talent products with the same product rigour as anything we'd ship externally.
* Work with highly sensitive employee and compensation data, following hx's data protection and security policies closely, and help shape them as our tools evolve.
* Grow into a genuinely unusual specialism: product engineering for People & Talent, sitting at the intersection of software engineering, UX, security, and people operations.
# What good looks like
**Within 3 months:** existing tools that have already been prototyped and tested, ones already proven to be incrementally helpful, are live in production and released to the business.
**Within 6 months:** a high-impact tool, such as compensation management, is built and in testing.
# What you'll need to have done
* 2-4 years' experience as a full stack or product engineer, having owned a tool or feature end to end, from spec through to production, not just contributed to someone else's build.
* Made significant UI/UX decisions with real users in mind, and can point to specific choices you made and why, not just features you shipped.
* Operated with real autonomy, as the primary or sole engineer on a project, comfortable making calls without close day-to-day technical supervision.
* Full stack development experience, front end and back end, including some ownership of data models and infrastructure decisions such as hosting, access control, and monitoring.
* Worked with sensitive or regulated data, or is comfortable operating within data protection and security policy constraints.
* Bonus, not required: prior exposure to People, HR, or Talent systems or processes.
# You're unlikely to thrive here if
* You've come from a People Ops or Talent background and picked up scripting or no-code skills, but haven't shipped and owned a production software product; this role needs software engineering depth, not enthusiasm for tools.
* You want a fully staffed engineering team around you for day-to-day technical support; this role is largely autonomous, with senior review rather than pairing.
* You're looking for a narrow, single-build project; this role's scope is designed to grow.
# Where this role goes
This isn't a well-trodden path, and that's the point. People & Talent teams are changing, and being able to build and deliver bespoke, in-house product is a reality we want to make the most of at hx. This role will prove that out and set the course for what a product engineering capability inside People & Talent looks like, not just at hx, but as a model for what this discipline can be. You'll be a product owner in every sense: shaping what gets built, why, and seeing the impact of your work in front of you, on real tools used by real people across the business, with the scope of that ownership growing as the capability proves itself.
# Compensation
At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.
Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.
Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this.
# Benefits
* £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.
* 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).
* Company pension scheme via Penfold.

* Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

You would help build a system that sits between complex map data and the teams that need usable simulation scenes. The work is partly product-facing and partly platform-facing: improving the search experience, strengthening the extraction pipeline, and making the output more reliable, scalable, and easy to consume.
This includes work on service integration, search logic, API-driven workflows, data transformation, and scene delivery. Depending on the role focus, it may also include improving performance, automation, output quality, and the flexibility of how scenes are generated and refined.
### What project we have for you
Scene Extract is a platform designed to turn natural-language requests into usable driving scenes for simulation, testing, and analysis. Instead of requiring users to manually search through large map datasets and build scenes piece by piece, the platform lets them describe what they need in plain language and then automatically identifies, extracts, and prepares the relevant scene. In simple terms, the platform helps users go from “describe the scenario” to “get a structured scene” much faster and with less manual effort.
The main purpose of Scene Extract project is to reduce the time and complexity involved in finding realistic road situations for development and validation work. It is especially valuable in environments where teams need many specific traffic, road, or infrastructure scenarios and cannot afford a slow, manual workflow.
The platform focuses on a few core outcomes:
* Make scene discovery easier by allowing users to search with everyday language rather than technical queries.
* Automate the extraction of relevant road and traffic context from available data sources.
* Prepare scenes in a structured format that can be reused in downstream tools and workflows.
* Improve consistency by standardizing how scenes are identified and generated.
At a high level, Scene Extract acts as a bridge between human intent and technical scene creation. A user provides a description of the situation they want, the platform interprets that request, locates matching map and environment elements, and produces an output that can be used for simulation or scenario-based work.
### What you will do
* Own full-stack architecture — make and document key technical decisions across frontend and backend, ensure they hold under scale and data volume
* Define API contracts and frontend component architecture that the team builds against — clear, versioned, unambiguous
* Lead technical discovery with BA/AI PM — translate product requirements into backend specs before they hit the engineers

## What is the opportunity?
Every go-to-market decision at Intercom, who we target, who owns the account, what we know about them, what we should say next - rests on a foundation of account and contact data. Getting that foundation right is one of the highest-leverage engineering problems in the company: a single account hierarchy fix can re-route territory, pipeline credit and forecast for thousands of accounts at once.
This role owns that foundation. You will build and run the systems that decide what an account *is*, resolving duplicates, stitching subsidiaries into corporate hierarchies, sourcing new accounts and contacts into our CRM, and enriching them with firmographic, technographic and intent signals. Increasingly using LLMs and web research rather than off-the-shelf vendors. Your work is used daily by Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Sales Ops and Finance, and directly shapes how efficiently Intercom grows.
You will sit in the Data group and partner extremely closely with GTM Systems, RevOps and the frontline teams. This is a role for an engineer who wants to be *in* the business, not adjacent to it. Someone who gets energy from a rep saying "this list is exactly right" and from watching a pipeline they built turn into revenue.
## What will I be doing?
* **Owning account identity.** Building and improving the entity-resolution layer that decides when two records are the same company: domain and firmographic matching, confidence scoring, and the merge/dedupe pipelines that keep Salesforce clean at scale.
* **Modelling account hierarchy.** Designing the organisation spine that links accounts to their parent, top operating parent and ultimate corporate parent.
* **Building account sourcing pipelines.** Turning market definitions into ranked, deduplicated, CRM-ready account lists: sourcing from third-party and internal signals, scoring fit, and pushing accounts into Salesforce with the right owner and the right metadata.
* **Building contact sourcing and enrichment pipelines.** Finding the right people at target accounts, verifying and enriching them, respecting privacy and consent requirements, and delivering them into the tools reps and marketers actually work in.
* **Building LLM-powered enrichment.** Extending our enrichment framework — LLM jobs with web search and crawling tools across multiple providers, to answer questions no vendor sells: what support channels does this company run, are they hiring CS or sales roles, do they ship an AI product, how ready are they for Fin.
* **Making the data usable.** Landing everything in well-modelled, well-tested dbt models in Snowflake orchestrated in Airflow, and syncing it out to Salesforce, Marketo, Clay and the rest of the GTM stack.
* **Owning quality and trust.** Instrumenting your pipelines with tests, alerts and reconciliation so problems surface before a rep finds them, and being the person GTM comes to when a number looks wrong.
* **Partnering on the problem, not the ticket.** Sitting with Sales, Marketing and Ops to understand what they are actually trying to do, then proposing the data foundation that unlocks it.
## What skills do I need?
* **A genuine interest in growing the business and a real affinity for GTM teams.** You are curious about how sales and marketing work, comfortable in a room full of reps, and motivated by commercial outcomes rather than only technical ones.
* Experience with the modern data stack: dbt, a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake), and a DAG orchestrator (we use Airflow).
* Experience building with LLMs in production: prompt design and evaluation, tool/function calling, web search and crawling, cost and latency control.
* Experience with entity resolution, identity or deduplication problems — matching messy real-world records, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs where a false merge has a real business cost.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SaaS APIs and business systems, especially Salesforce: reading from them, writing back to them.
* Strong communication: you can explain a hierarchy change to a CRO and a merge heuristic to an engineer, on the same day.
* A growth mindset and eagerness to learn — the tooling in this space is changing fast.
## Nice to haves
* Experience with GTM data vendors and tooling — ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, Clay, Crossbeam, Marketo, Census/Fivetran, Gong.
* Experience with territory design, account scoring, propensity models or ICP definition.
* Exposure to privacy and compliance considerations around contact data (GDPR, CCPA, consent management).

* **12 months.** You've taken on a wider range of case types with less oversight, and you've surfaced at least one concrete piece of SOP friction or noise that a senior analyst was able to act on.

What we are looking for is ownership and hunger to improve the status quo. At steady state, we’re working to move our transaction-monitoring true-positive rate from the low single digits today toward 50-60% - that’s the direction of travel this role drives.

### Must-Haves

# Senior Product Designer — XR, Spatial UX & AI
## Description
Lucid Reality Labs is a team creating enterprise XR and AI products that make training safer, learning more effective, and complex work easier to perform. Our projects include immersive safety and skills training, simulations, digital twins, and intelligent XR experiences.
We are looking for a senior Product Designer who can raise the design quality of our products end to end: from intuitive spatial interactions and training flows to polished, premium visual experiences.
h2. **Your mission**
You will make complex XR products feel clear, natural, and engaging in real use not only look good in Figma.
You will lead the design of flows, interfaces, spatial interactions, feedback systems, and visual direction for products used in VR, AR, mixed reality, and 2D companion interfaces. You will work closely with product managers, Unity/XR developers, 3D artists, technical artists, and clients.
## Responsibilities
h2.
* Own product design from discovery to delivery: user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, UI, spatial interaction rules, specifications, and design QA.
* Design intuitive XR interactions for hand tracking, controllers, poke, ray, gaze, and other input methods.
* Create clear interaction states for complex tasks for example, camera tools, scanning, hazard identification, assessment, and review flows.
* Make interactions forgiving and accessible: define input tolerances, feedback, error prevention, recovery states, and clear next steps.
* Design effective tutorial and training flows, including guidance, acknowledgment of correct and incorrect actions, progress, and performance feedback.
* Create high-quality visual interfaces with strong hierarchy, readability, proportional typography and icons, contrast, depth, motion, and responsive feedback.
* Build and maintain scalable design systems for XR and 2D product interfaces.
* Improve the visual quality of experiences through thoughtful UI styling, micro-interactions, lighting and environment direction in collaboration with 3D and technical-art teams.
* Run usability testing in-headset, identify friction early, and turn insights into prioritised improvements.
* Translate client feedback and business requirements into clear design decisions and developer-ready acceptance criteria.
* Lead design reviews and raise the quality bar across a small, fast-moving multidisciplinary team.
## Requirements
* 5+ years of product-design experience, with a portfolio of high-quality shipped digital products.
* Strong experience in VR, AR, MR, games, simulations, or other spatial-computing products. This is a core requirement.
* Excellent visual-design craft: typography, layout, colour, hierarchy, motion, component design, and premium UI styling.
* Deep understanding of human-centred interaction design, especially for task-based, immersive, or hands-on workflows.
* Experience designing user feedback, system status, learning flows, error states, and success criteria.
* Advanced Figma skills, including components, auto layout, variables, prototyping, and design systems.
* Ability to make clear design decisions in ambiguous environments and explain the reasoning to clients and teammates.
* Experience collaborating closely with developers and the ability to create practical, implementation-ready specifications.
* Strong spoken and written English.
**Especially valuable**
* Experience with Unity, Unreal, or another real-time 3D environment.
* Experience designing training, safety, healthcare, industrial, manufacturing, or regulated enterprise products.
* Familiarity with hand tracking, controller interactions, spatial ergonomics, accessibility, and comfort in XR.
* Experience directing visual quality alongside 3D artists, animators, and technical artists.
* Experience with AI-powered products or intelligent assistant interfaces.
**What success looks like**
Within the first months, you will bring more structure, consistency, and quality to how we design XR products. You will help us create interfaces that are easy to understand at first use, interactions that work reliably in real conditions, training experiences that give users meaningful feedback, and visuals that feel polished, immersive, and premium.
## What We Offer
* Competitive salary
* 24 days annual vacation days
* 7 working days per year for sick leave
* Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely
* Open-minded and outside-the-box ideas embodied in life
* Award-winning and diverse team to grow together
* Friendly team and a great working environment
Join us, and together, let's make a positive impact on how we experience life!

The Backend team develops the core of the Alta Video Management System. These are Cloud based distributed systems monitoring and managing Video Cameras, Access Control Systems and Sensors. The Backend team is responsible for analyzing, developing, designing, and maintaining the entire backend ecosystem. This includes developing new features, adding capabilities and increasing capacities, along with maintaining the existing CI/CD systems and customer deployments.
We are an agile team that prides ourselves in allowing great autonomy and valuing collaboration, quality and security throughout.

Has experience working as a software developer.
Has experience in building the backend for large cloud based distributed systems.

Is looking for a career where their creative abilities will make a difference to the world of technology and where they will be part of an impressive R&D environment.

Understanding of service-oriented architectures and building cloud-based products.
Experience with Machine Learning, Computer Vision, AI technologies.
We are looking for a team player who thinks holistically, enjoys solving complex problems and thrives working autonomously, while not afraid to ask for input and learn from their teammates if they’re stuck.
We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace spawns innovation – the more diverse our employees are, the more ideas and talents we have to excel as a leader in the technology sector. **Job Purpose Summary**
The purpose of this post is to work as part of NatureScot’s Peatland ACTION Delivery Team developing and managing , policy, guidance, and processes to support the successful delivery of restoration projects.
The post will also provide specialist advice and technical expertise on peatland issues. The range of tasks is varied and will therefore require a well-developed understanding of peatland ecology and restoration. The ability to plan and organise their own workload is required to deliver the corporate priorities, evaluate different approaches, problem solve and provide a range of solutions.
The post covers the whole of Scotland and will require the ability to travel independently, as public transport is not always available and site are remote. On occasions, this will require travel that necessitates nights away from home.
The post holder will be required to be based in mainland Scotland to carry out the essential operational duties.
**Context**
NatureScot’s Peatland programme delivers actions to protect, manage, and restore Scotland’s peatlands. It supports the Scottish Government’s Climate Change Plan which, in part, aims to restore 400,000ha of degraded peatland by 2040. The programme is integral to the government’s determination for peatlands to provide a range of benefits for people, nature, and climate e.g. better water quality and flow regulation, increased levels biodiversity, reduced carbon emissions, and the further development of the green economy.
As part of the Peatland ACTION partnership, NatureScot has a dual role in providing leadership on shared services/business solutions across all delivery partners and expanding delivery of peatland restoration on the ground.

* Develop and manage a new Restoration Aftercare Programme. This will be important to understand the efficacy of restoration and enable follow-up works to be targeted.

**Communication**

* Experience of developing and drafting policy, guidance and process development documentation.
* Understanding of peatland ecology, wetland hydrology and upland management, including knowledge and experience of peatland restoration techniques.
* Experience of managing projects and contracts – ideally related to conservation land management.

* Experience of working with land managers and their representatives.

# Senior ServiceNow Developer
The Senior ServiceNow Developer is the most senior hands-on technical authority for the ServiceNow platform underpinning our cybersecurity managed services. The role designs, builds and maintains complex, heavily customised applications in an environment where out-of-the-box functionality is not sufficient: scoped applications, custom data models, advanced server- and client-side scripting, and integrations with security tooling and customer environments. It demands expert-level JavaScript, a rigorous approach to performance, maintainability and upgradeability, and the judgement to know when to configure, when to customise, and when to challenge the requirement. Because the platform delivers a live managed service to external customers, the post holder works directly with customers and service stakeholders on requirements, technical escalations and service impact, and is accountable for solutions that hold up under contractual service commitments. As the technical lead within the development team, the post holder sets the technical standard, owns code review and architectural direction, and mentors and develops the wider team.
## Key Responsibilities
* **Technical Leadership:** Act as the technical authority for the platform: own architectural direction and technical standards, make and document the significant design decisions, and provide the final technical sign-off before code is promoted.
* **Complex Application Development:** Design and build scoped applications, custom data models and business logic that go well beyond out-of-the-box capability, while keeping the instance supportable and upgradeable.
* **Advanced Scripting and JavaScript Engineering:** Write, review and refactor advanced server-side and client-side JavaScript across Script Includes, Business Rules, GlideAjax, Scripted REST APIs, UI Scripts, UI Actions and Service Portal widgets, applying sound engineering practice within the constraints of the platform.
* **Customer-Facing Solution Design:** Work directly with customers and service stakeholders to shape requirements into technical designs, explain trade-offs and constraints in plain language, and ensure what is delivered is operable within the managed service and its contractual commitments.
* **Integrations:** Design and build robust integrations with external systems, security tooling and customer platforms using REST and SOAP, including authentication, error handling, retry behaviour and monitoring.
* **Platform Health and Upgradeability:** Own the technical quality of a heavily customized, multi-customer set of instances: performance tuning, reduction of technical debt, upgrade impact analysis and remediation of skipped or broken customisations.
* **Code Review and Technical Standards:** Set and enforce coding standards, secure development practice and peer review across the team, and drive consistent, measurable improvement in code quality.
* **Complex Troubleshooting and Escalation:** Act as the final escalation point for the most complex defects and customer-impacting production issues, including root cause analysis across integrations, ACLs, asynchronous processing and performance, and communicate findings to service and customer stakeholders.
* **Mentoring and Capability Building:** Coach developers and administrators through pairing, design reviews and technical walkthroughs; grow the technical depth of the team and reduce single points of knowledge.
* **Documentation:** Produce and maintain technical documentation, integration specifications and runbooks to a standard that allows others to support and extend the work.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with ServiceNow administrators, frontend developers, UX and service delivery colleagues to ensure solutions are implemented and operated seamlessly end to end.

* Hands-on ServiceNow development experience, including a minimum of 3 years in complex, heavily customised, multi-application enterprise instances rather than out-of-the-box implementations
* Expert-level JavaScript: strong command of server-side scripting within the platform's runtime as well as modern client-side JavaScript, including debugging, refactoring and performance-conscious code
* Demonstrable experience as the most senior technical developer on a platform or team: setting standards, owning code review, making architectural decisions and mentoring other developers
* Experience delivering ServiceNow within a managed service, MSP or multi-customer environment, including direct engagement with customers on requirements, technical escalations and service impact
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* Expert knowledge of platform development: scoped applications, data model and table design, Business Rules, Script Includes, GlideRecord and GlideAggregate, ACLs, Flow Designer, scheduled jobs and asynchronous processing
* Deep knowledge of ServiceNow client and server APIs, including Scripted REST APIs, GlideAjax and the differences between scoped and global application development
* Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations (REST, SOAP, OAuth and SSO patterns) with external and customer-side systems
* Demonstrable experience of performance tuning, advanced debugging and diagnosing complex platform issues in production
* Experience of platform upgrades on a customised instance, including impact analysis and remediation
* Secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practice, structured release management and version control (update sets, application repositories, ATF, CI/CD)
* Ability to work autonomously, own delivery end to end, and set technical direction for others
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs and service impact to non-technical and customer stakeholders
**Desirable Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems or a related field
* Additional ServiceNow certifications (CIS in relevant modules, Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect)

# Associate Cloud Security Engineer
We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good. We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey.
###### **Role Overview**
We seek a motivated Cloud Security Engineer at a junior to mid-level to help implement and manage robust security controls for our cloud-based platforms. The ideal candidate will have a growing background in cybersecurity engineering coupled with cloud practices, and a strong appetite to learn. As a Cloud Security Engineer, you will play an important role in safeguarding our business cloud environments against potential threats and vulnerabilities. Working alongside senior engineers and the broader technology team, you will help identify vulnerabilities, develop solutions, and deploy effective controls to ensure our data and systems' confidentiality, integrity, and availability. This is a hands-on growth role that requires solid technical foundations and a genuine interest in information security best practices.
###### **Location**
This position will be based in either our Frankfurt (Germany) or London (United Kingdom) office. The candidate is required to attend the office a minimum of 3 days per week but may voluntarily elect to work either remotely or from the office for the remaining days of the week.
###### **Key Responsibilities**
* Support the design and implementation of security controls for cloud-based platforms, helping ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations such as ISO 27001, FedRAMP, NIST, IRAP, and SOC 2.
* Assist with technical risk assessments of cloud infrastructure and applications, helping identify potential security gaps and recommending countermeasures.
* Assist with the development and maintenance of cyber security technical controls and operations, standards, and procedures for cloud deployments in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Support technical third-party security audits and assessments.
* Help identify and assess vulnerabilities, risks, and cyber security threats and their impact on Nuix's platforms and applications.
* Help implement and configure security controls across various cloud services, such as AWS and Azure.
* Participate in incident response activities under guidance, including supporting investigations of security breaches and helping implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Monitor and analyse security logs, alerts, and events to help identify and respond to security incidents and threats.
* Collaborate with development and operations teams to help integrate security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and DevOps processes.
* Help manage and maintain security infrastructure, including vulnerability scan tools, intrusion detection and prevention systems, anti-malware solutions, and other security platforms.
###### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
* Tertiary qualification in Computer Science or related field, or relevant experience.
* Up to 3 years of experience in cybersecurity or IT roles, with some exposure to cloud security (including internships, graduate programs or relevant project work). Candidates at the mid-level end may have 2–3 years with focused cloud security experience.
* Some experience working as an IT Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on information security, is desirable.
* Foundational knowledge of network and system security principles, practices, protocols, and technologies.
* Hands-on exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, O365 and Azure.
* Working knowledge of security technologies and protocols, such as Vulnerability tools, Data protection, encryption, IAM, endpoint detection, and event/incident management.
* Familiarity with industry security standards and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, NIST, and CSA.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to tackle complex security issues and develop effective solutions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Entry-level or associate certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals AZ-900, CompTIA Security+, or working towards AWS Certified Security – Specialty / CCSP) preferred.
* Experience with scripting and automation tools for security tasks (e.g., Python, PowerShell) is a plus.
* Awareness of EMEA regulatory and data-protection requirements (e.g., GDPR) is a plus.

# Staff Security Engineer - Security Operations
United Kingdom
**About Pantheon**
Pantheon is the WebOps platform for websites that deliver extraordinary results. We believe in putting the magic of the internet in everyone’s hands. That’s why we’re so passionate about helping developers, IT and marketing develop, test, and release As a Staff Security Engineer, SecOps, you’ll be the strategic and technical anchor of Pantheon’s security operations function — setting the long-term direction for detection, response, and operational resilience while staying hands-on with the hardest engineering problems. This role operates at the intersection of architecture, program leadership, and deep technical execution: you will define how Pantheon detects and responds to threats at scale, own the maturity roadmap for the SecOps capability, and drive alignment across Engineering, Infrastructure, GRC, and executive leadership.
At the staff level, your impact extends beyond your own output. You’ll shape how the broader engineering organisation thinks about security, influence tooling and platform decisions across teams, and serve as a principal voice for SecOps in architectural and product discussions. You will also be Pantheon’s lead on EU regulatory requirements — NIS2, GDPR, and related frameworks — ensuring operational controls meet the bar required for a company operating in the Irish and broader European market. Pantheon’s core values are Trust, Teamwork, Passion, and Customers First. We value individuality, humour, and balance, and we actively contribute to open-source communities. If you’re ready to own the security operations vision at a company that ships critical infrastructure for hundreds of thousands of sites, this is your role.
### **The Role**
As a Senior Security Engineer, SecOps, you’ll be the backbone of Pantheon’s security operations — designing, implementing, and running the detection and response capabilities that keep our platform and customers safe. You will lead efforts in threat detection, incident response, and operational resilience, while driving automation and scalable processes to mature Pantheon’s security posture.
This is a hands-on role with leadership expectations: you’ll own key SecOps technologies, shape incident response strategy, and mentor engineers across teams in security best practices.
Pantheon’s core values are **Trust, Teamwork, Passion, and Customers First**. We value individuality, humor, and balance, and we actively contribute to open-source communities. If you’re excited about modern SecOps and thrive on solving complex security problems, this is the place for you.
### **What You'll Do**
* **SecOps Strategy & Roadmap:** Define, own, and execute a multi-year roadmap for Pantheon’s security operations capability — covering detection engineering, incident response, threat intelligence, exposure management, and abuse prevention. Translate security risk into prioritised engineering investments.
* **Architecture & Platform Ownership:** Lead the architecture of Pantheon’s SecOps toolchain (SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud security posture, identity monitoring). Evaluate, select, and integrate security platforms with a focus on long-term scalability and operational efficiency.
* **Threat Detection at Scale:** Drive the detection engineering programme — building a library of high-fidelity, low-noise detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, tuned across cloud, endpoint, and identity surfaces. Establish the methodology and standards the team operates against.
* **Incident Response Leadership:** Own the incident response programme end-to-end: playbooks, runbooks, severity frameworks, post-incident reviews, and continuous improvement cycles. Lead response for the most complex and critical incidents; serve as technical escalation path for the team.
* **Threat Intelligence Programme:** Build and operate a structured threat intelligence capability — ingesting, contextualising, and operationalising intelligence from internal telemetry, commercial feeds, ISACs, and open-source sources to inform detection and response priorities.
* **Automation & Engineering Excellence:** Architect and deliver scalable automation across alert triage, enrichment, investigation, and response using SOAR, APIs, and scripting. Raise the engineering bar for how SecOps builds and maintains its tooling.
* **EU Regulatory & Compliance Leadership:** Serve as the SecOps subject matter expert for GDPR, NIS2, and relevant EU and Irish regulatory obligations. Partner with GRC and Legal to ensure operational controls satisfy audit, regulatory, and contractual requirements — including SOC 2, PCI DSS, and NIST CSF.
* **Vulnerability & Exposure Management:** Define the programme strategy for vulnerability triage, prioritisation, and remediation SLAs in partnership with Engineering and Infrastructure. Drive down mean time to remediation through automation and clear ownership models.
* **Abuse & Fraud Prevention:** Own the technical strategy for abuse monitoring — credential attacks, account takeover, platform misuse — designing controls that scale with Pantheon’s customer growth.
* **Business Resilience:** Lead SecOps participation in business continuity and disaster recovery planning. Design and run tabletop exercises, red team collaboration, and resilience testing programmes.
* **Executive Communication:** Produce programme-level metrics, risk narratives, and strategic briefings for senior leadership and the board. Translate operational data into business risk language.
* **Engineering Enablement & Mentorship:** Set the technical standard for SecOps practices across Pantheon. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, run security training programmes, and embed security thinking in engineering teams through pairing, review, and design consultation.
### **What You Bring to the Table**
* 10+ years of experience in information security, with 7+ years focused on security operations — spanning detection engineering, incident response, threat hunting, or SecOps programme leadership.
* Deep expertise in architecting and operating enterprise-grade SIEM and SOAR platforms at scale (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic SIEM, Palo Alto XSOAR, Tines).
* Strong hands-on background in cloud-native security across GCP and/or AWS — including logging pipelines, cloud security posture management, and IAM monitoring.
* Expert-level knowledge of attack techniques and threat actor tradecraft (MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND) and the ability to translate that into detection logic and response procedures.
* Demonstrated experience leading major incident response — including managing stakeholders, running cross-functional war rooms, and driving post-incident improvement.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, or equivalent) applied to security engineering problems — not just tooling configuration.
* Experience owning or materially contributing to EU regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR, NIS2) from an operational security perspective.
* Track record of influencing technical direction beyond your immediate team — through design reviews, architecture documents, or cross-functional programme leadership.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical risk clearly to both engineering audiences and executive leadership.
### **Preferred Experience**
* Holding one or more recognized security certifications: CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIA, GCED, GREM, GDAT), OSCP, or a cloud security specialty certification (GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty).
* Experience building or scaling a detection engineering programme from the ground up, including establishing detection coverage metrics and a continuous improvement cadence.
* Hands-on with threat intelligence platforms (e.g., Recorded Future, Mandiant Advantage) and structured intelligence lifecycle management.
* Background in abuse monitoring, phishing detection, and takedown coordination with registrars, hosting providers, and law enforcement.
* Exposure to bug bounty programme operations and red team/purple team collaboration to validate detection coverage.
* Experience managing security vendor relationships, running RFPs, and making build-vs-buy decisions for operational tooling.
* Prior experience working within the Irish or EU regulatory environment — familiarity with the Data Protection Commission (DPC), NIS2 obligations for essential/important entities, or ENISA guidance is a plus.
### **What We Offer**
We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.
* Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
* Robust Vacation Package with 28 days of Holiday
* Private medical and dental coverage

* Access to Employee Resource Platform

* Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development
* Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate
